tpms.when: 2016 G 550 and G 63 AMG with the tire pressure monitor in the cluster Serv. menu
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the tire and loading sticker on the driver's door pillar.
Switch the ignition on (key in position 2) and stay parked.
Use the left and right arrow buttons on the steering wheel to reach the Serv. menu.
Use the up and down arrows to choose Tire Pressure and press OK. Each tire's pressure shows, or a message that they will appear after a few minutes of driving.
Press the down arrow button. The display asks whether to use the current pressures as the new reference values.
Press OK to confirm. The display shows that the tire pressure monitor has restarted. Press the back button instead if you want to cancel.
tpms.note: If the tire warning lamp flashes for about a minute and then stays on, the monitor itself has a fault, and a restart will not clear it.

notes: The 2016 G-Class manual shows how to view the ASSYST service due date in the cluster but the part we read gave no driver reset, so only the tire pressure restart is listed.
